name: sponge
title: Sponge
description: Save links and search your reading library with the Sponge CLI installed on your Mac.
author: 0thernet

commands.name: save-url
commands.title: Save URL
commands.subtitle: Sponge
commands.description: Save a link to your Sponge library. Uses the clipboard when no URL is entered.

commands.name: search-library
commands.title: Search Library
commands.subtitle: Sponge
commands.description: Search the saved text in your Sponge library.

commands.name: recent-items
commands.title: Show Recent Items
commands.subtitle: Sponge
commands.description: Browse the newest items in your Sponge library.

preferences.name: cliPath
preferences.title: Sponge CLI
preferences.description: The sponge command, if it is not in /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin or your npm global folder.

preferences.name: library
preferences.title: Library Folder
preferences.description: An existing Sponge library. Leave empty to use your default library.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
